verdicts.reason: A: the blue panel is centred, but the Meridian logo floats off-axis to the right over light sky, where it has weak contrast. Inside the panel there is too much empty space, and the Book Now button sits right of centre, out of line with the left-aligned headline and subline. B: the panel is shoved left, leaving a 164px strip of empty sea on the right, and it is not aligned with the canvas-centred logo above it. The button again floats off the text's left edge, and the panel nearly touches the bottom of the canvas. A is slightly better balanced, so it wins narrowly.
